formal.scoring: Correct verdicts require a replayed model or an independent UNSAT decision on the identical input hash; unresolved results receive PAR-2 penalty.

before.boundary: Native model-phase capability reproduction on unchanged floating kernel; not an SMT verdict or performance score.

after.boundary: Native same-source model-phase validation of the shared exact evaluator; not an SMT verdict or performance score.

earlier_pilot.scope: Preserved negative performance pilot; adoption is now a correctness/API decision under explicit user direction.

interface: Propagator::decisionSource(DecisionContext) chooses SatActivity or TheoryModel per request; explicit unassigned decide() picks retain priority; default TheoryModel selection and complete-model checks remain unchanged.
implementation: LRA and LIA delegate exact model-point evaluation to LinearAtomManager; rational arithmetic and infinitesimals are preserved. No new default branching algorithm, feature gate or external runtime oracle.
